title: Mauritius calculator-readiness review — Batch 29

regional_lookup.note: Nine geographic districts on the main island plus Rodrigues as an autonomous island. Mauritius census notes the nine districts are geographic units rather than administrative entities; Rodrigues is autonomous.

new_evidence: 2025 provisional official sugarcane: 2,321,704 tonnes from 33,805 ha, mean yield 68.68 t/ha.
2025 food crops: open field 175,122.2 t from 9,991.1 ha; covered culture 14,249.9 t from 123 ha. These systems must remain separate.
2025 poultry meat 57,000 t; pork 695 t; beef 2,199 t of which 2,175 t from imported cattle and 24 t local.
Jan-Jun 2026 open-field food crop production 74,768.8 t; covered-culture 8,144.8 t; poultry 25,900 t. Partial-year only.
2024 Census: 24,145 agricultural holdings excluding sugarcane/tea-only holdings; 19,246 Mauritius Island and 4,899 Rodrigues; livestock and land summaries recorded.
Q2 2026 PPI-A index recorded; not absolute farmgate prices. FAREI APMIS current market price portal identified, but raw current prices not extracted.
safeguards: Do not treat PPI-A indices or retail/wholesale prices as absolute farmgate prices
Imported animal slaughter must not be labelled local livestock production
Keep original ten active countries unchanged
